releases.name: duo-editor
releases.description: The Duo editor on iPhone Duo: the claim on the left page and question cards on the right, built on Xcode Cloud and shipped to TestFlight testers.

clusters.title: iPhone Duo editor: one claim, one refutation, on TestFlight
clusters.description: The native slices of CIT-439: the iOS project, the build-time JSON bundle, the Xcode Cloud workflows, the supervisor reading their results, and the SwiftUI app. The Linux-capable pieces run through the agent first; the one-time Xcode Cloud setup needs the maintainer on a Mac.

escalate.question: Apple only lets the first Xcode Cloud workflow be created in Xcode on a Mac, which takes about an hour on a borrowed Mac or an hourly rented cloud Mac (AWS Mac bills a 24-hour minimum). Do you do this setup yourself, or approve renting a cloud Mac for it?
